gloss: House of Representatives election; general election

definitions.explanation: An election for Japan's House of Representatives, the short news form of {衆議院議員選挙|しゅうぎいんぎいんせんきょ}. It follows the end of a four-year term or, more often, a dissolution of the house, and decides which party forms the government.

examples.japanese: {衆院選|しゅういんせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まった→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
examples.english: The lower-house election campaign has begun.

examples.japanese: {衆院選|しゅういんせん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{与党|よとう}→与党：05241_yotou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{勝|か}った→勝つ：01199_katsu⟧。
examples.english: The ruling party won the general election.

examples.japanese: ⟦{首相|しゅしょう}→首相：03217_shushou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{衆院|しゅういん}→衆院：32455_shuuin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{解散|かいさん}した→解散する：21678_kaisansuru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧{衆院選|しゅういんせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われる→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: Because the prime minister dissolved the lower house, a general election will be held next month.

notes:
Made of ⟦{衆院|しゅういん}→衆院：32455_shuuin⟧ (lower house) + ⟦{選|せん}→選：09879_sen⟧ (election, as in ⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧). The upper-house counterpart is {参院選|さんいんせん}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {衆院選|しゅういんせん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{投票日|とうひょうび}: polling day
- {衆院選|しゅういんせん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立候補|りっこうほ}→立候補：13778_rikkouho⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to run in the general election
- {衆院選|しゅういんせん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧: the election results

USAGE:
English-language news usually calls it a general election, since it is the vote that decides the government.
